data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. We sincerely apologize for the disruption caused by the recent v4.2 update. Because the SSO token format has changed, you need to log into your CloudDesk Admin Console and re-upload your IDP metadata to restore connectivity. This will resolve the AUTH-SSO-401.1 errors and allow your team to authenticate for your presentation. [T-4752] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
